frame: geographic-frame.json; existing anchor, metres and bearing unchanged
photos: Owner photographs IMG_0855-0866, 29 October 2026, inspected locally. None is shipped or used as a texture. Also reviewed IMG_1074-1082, 1 November 2026.
basis: Everything here is a visual estimate read from those photographs, placed against the existing mapped lanes and outlines. Nothing was surveyed.

apron.basis: 0855-0857: the junction in front of the Nishi gate is asphalt from wall to planting bed, with no lawn or sand footway.

asphaltLane.basis: IMG_1074-1081: flush asphalt reaches the fence and rounded island kerb through the tennis-lot lane; no separate paved sidewalk or lawn ribbon.

nishiCypress.basis: 0990, 0997: a tall leaning cypress row behind the low stone wall, with bare trunks at its foot. Height estimated.

diamonds.basis: 0980, 1004: teal crossing-ahead diamond with a white frame, in the left lane. Size estimated.

cypress.basis: 0857-0860: a tall dark clipped cypress screen behind a rusted white fence on a concrete block footing.

junctionBed.basis: IMG_0997-1004 and IMG_1075-1081 including panorama/video: an independent triangular island between the three arms. OSM way 59265929 provides the omitted western arm; the earlier estimate placed the island east of the shortcut, inside the grass lot. Shape, tree position and dimensions remain estimates.

villa.basis: 0858-0860: grey two-storey building with a hipped slate roof, chimney and arched door beyond the open lot. GSI envelope registered in university-layout.js; facade identity remains a photo-relative interpretation.

samuraiWall.basis: 0863: mortared stone base, grey plaster, tile coping and a white end wall, on the right of the road east of the bend.

rampart.basis: 0866: continuous stone rampart at the foot of the wooded bank. Height estimated; the retained bank line is not re-registered.

schoolPlanting.basis: 0864-0865: clipped azaleas in a kerbed bed with chain posts, paired steles, fan palms, a tall hedge and a dark direction post.

limits: The inner road now follows registered OSM way/121393441, checked against IMG_1071/1072 on 2026-11-01. The western water boundary is recorded in castle-moat.json; photo fixes still locate cameras, not subjects.
Species are silhouette recipes, not botanical identification.
Signs and notices are simplified readable graphics of what the photographs show, not verified regulations; unreadable text is not transcribed.

smokingNotice.basis: IMG_0992 (2026-10-31), photo-relative estimate beside the stone corner, not the camera GPS point.

crossing.basis: IMG_0991, 0993, 0995 (2026-10-31) and Street View 8WoHMsMgJcvNfwFXje9tbw (November 2022, headings 20, 170, 240). Offsets in metres along (u) and across (v) the road axis from x = origin; photo-relative estimates, not surveyed. The panorama shows green between the zebra stripes; by 2026 only traces remain, so it is not painted.

lotWear.basis: IMG_1074/1075/1079/1080: grass dominates the open lot, with irregular pale vehicle tracks. Track plan and widths are estimates.
